description: Resolves icon-font names into inline SVG markup via the public Iconify API (https://iconify.design/docs/api/). Accepts Material Symbols refs ("ms:verified"), Font Awesome refs ("fa:chart-line"), Iconify ids ("mdi:home"), or bare names (treated as Material Symbols); underscores become hyphens, and Material Symbols resolve to the outlined variant with a filled fallback. These are the same `ms:` / `fa:` refs that ingest results report in block.icon. Returns { icons: { "<ref>": { ok, svg, iconify } } }. In Webcake an icon renders as an SVG mask on a rectangle element: the SVG goes in responsive.desktop.config.svgMask and responsive.mobile.config.svgMask (each breakpoint is read separately), the visible color comes from styles.background (the SVG's own fill is ignored), and the mask is stretched to the box (preserveAspectRatio='none'), so a square box keeps its proportions. No Webcake credentials needed.

icons.description: Icon references to resolve (1–40), e.g. ["ms:verified", "ms:support_agent", "fa:chart-line"] — typically the block.icon values from an ingest result.

name: get_icon_svg
